commit.subject: LU-20741: lfs: find remote file and directory
commit.message:
LU-20741: lfs: find remote file and directory

This patch add two new features to lfs-find :
* --remote: allow to filter files and directories that are not on the
            same MDT that their parent directory
* New printf format:
    * %LR: print the MDT index of the parent directory
    * %Lm: print the MDT index of the file/directory

BTW, it fixes an indentation issue on lfs-find manpage.
